summary: Fixed the ledger package to follow docs/conventions.md: half-away-from-zero rounding via ledger.core everywhere, single leading minus in formatting and HTML totals, header-over-dialect layout precedence, rate lookback to earlier months only, month-range import in the rate file reader, reversals booked and valued at their original's date, sums of per-entry rounded values, fiscal-year boundary, tax rules effective on their start date, returns by valuation quarter, and the writer always writing the jurisdiction. All 755 tests pass and tools/audit.py reports 0 failed checks.
